West wind awake! and comb / Our garden blade from blade— / We, in our little home, / Sit unafraid.

—
Upon New Year’s Eve
, ll. 37–40.

Sir Arthur Thomas

Quiller-Couch

The Oxford Book of Victorian Verse

Chosen by Sir Arthur Thomas Quiller-Couch

These 779 selections from 273 English, American and others poets span the 19th and early 20th centuries.
